Validate packs

Checks each pack checkout: composer.json (type ichava-icon-set), the manifest, that a pack config syncs it, its sets, licence files, empty categories, files that are not SVGs and, if you ask, every SVG against the toolkit's parser. The CLI is icon-sets-sync validate.
